scope: UCM 24-step matched on-policy fine-tuning pilot starting from the historical deployment LoRA; all ASSET files read-only. Final step only. Base comparator is the unchanged historical policy.
training: 24 distinct train pictures (12 reciprocal reviewed pairs). One image per step, G=8 stochastic samples, temperature 1. Identical image order, seeds, neutral scene cue, tool loop and hyperparameters. Historical tool threshold 0. AdamW 5e-6, group sample-standardized return, sum of generated token log-probabilities (including actually emitted EOS), per-step grad clip 1. No post-generation padding or feedback tokens in the loss.
old: Existing format score plus reciprocal rank of the true image in 1680 train image proxy gallery; frozen reconstructed proxy.
caption: Midrank within the group of actual image/first positive train-caption cosine minus the largest negative cosine on fixed even-hash train caption pool. Exclude all five of the source image's true caption token groups. Neutral cue never includes the caption.
hard: Mean of caption-reward midrank and the midrank of the cosine margin between pixel-verified true relation A and its same-scene false counterpart (only the target detail is changed). One fixed A wording. B unused in training.
evaluation: Deploy each adapter at its final step. True 210 UCM validation photos, original first caption, greedy, native historical scene loop. Use all 1050 raw caption owners with exact tie handling and deduplicated encoding, six recalls plus mR. Also evaluate a locked new object-detail panel on original and 180-degree-rotated views with the same neutral scene prompt; no scoring-time choice using labels. Primary detail metric: mean accuracy of two evaluation wordings, both views must be correct per wording, single greedy deployment. Add 4 stochastic draws per view as secondary, and per-source bootstrap. Only release final comparison after all three arms. No formal test access or downstream retraining.
interpretation: Prefer a candidate only if BOTH whole-val mR and new-object both-view accuracy exceed the old-reward short update, without lowering either metric relative to the starting policy. This is a pilot promotion rule, no policy deployment.
